_help: Copy to brand.json. Every key below is read by clip.py (field > env TOMMY_<KEY> > this file). Colours are hex without #. Booleans: true/false. watermark = text like @name OR a path to a PNG logo. watermark_pos: tl tr bl br bounce. position: auto top middle bottom. aspects: [] or any of 1:1, 4:5. lang: '' or es fr pt de ar hi. Keys starting with _ are ignored. theme: '' or a name from themes.json (vice-nights clean neon bold-yellow minimal-white; default vice-nights, none = off); look order theme < brand.json < pick fields. flip: true = stacked layouts put the cam BELOW the game.
